comparison.method: Git blob SHA1 computed from original bytes and compared with the complete file trees of main and six open PR heads; archive integrity also checked with SHA256.

interpretation.reused-main: Identical bytes are already stored in main at the pinned path; this does not establish gameplay use or artistic approval.
interpretation.referenced-open-pr: Identical bytes found only in an open PR; not counted as merged or stored on main.
interpretation.reused-recovery-source: Identical source bytes occur elsewhere in these recovered packs and have one canonical destination.
interpretation.recovered-source-file: Original bytes preserved in this local recovery change; publication must be confirmed separately.
